issues.description: Trailing audio in packetization buffer is never flushed on stream end or interruption.
issues.detail: _audio_send_buffer holds the remainder shorter than fixed_audio_packet_size with no terminal flush on EndFrame/Cancel/StopFrame. Final audio is silently dropped, weakening the serializer's postcondition that serialized bytes reach the wire. Pad-and-flush on end-of-stream or document the lossy contract explicitly.

issues.description: Packetization path applies to all bytes payloads and leaks a serializer-specific concern into the generic transport.
issues.detail: _write_frame buffers any bytes payload as PCM whenever fixed_audio_packet_size is set, corrupting non-audio binary messages. The 20ms Vonage framing also belongs to the serializer, not the generic transport. Gate on AudioRawFrame and/or factor this into a composing packetizer serializer wrapper.

issues.description: _write_frame conflates serialize+buffer+chunk+send and oversells pacing it does not implement.
issues.detail: The while-loop emits all full packets back-to-back; _send_interval/_next_send_time pacing is unchanged or bypassed, despite the PR billing 'real-time pacing.' Extract a small stateless chunker filter and either implement pacing or rename to reflect framing-only behavior. Honest naming and one responsibility per function.

issues.description: DTMF parsing accepts two undocumented message shapes.
issues.detail: deserialize tries message['digit'] then message['dtmf']['digit'] with no spec reference. Pick the documented Vonage shape, reject or log the other as a compatibility shim with a TODO. Defensive coding around fuzzy data hides protocol drift indefinitely.

issues.description: PCM16 format is asserted in comments but never enforced.
issues.detail: serialize/deserialize claim 16-bit linear PCM, and fixed_audio_packet_size silently assumes alignment to bytes_per_sample*channels. Nothing checks frame.format, sample width, or packet-size alignment. A caller passing 8-bit, float, or 641-byte packets produces misaligned garbage. Add an assert or raise on StartFrame.

issues.description: Renaming audio_packet_bytes to fixed_audio_packet_size is a silent breaking change.
issues.detail: The param sits on a public dataclass with Optional default None, so existing users of audio_packet_bytes lose packetization without error. Keep a deprecated alias for one release or call out the break loudly in the changelog. Silent behavior changes are the worst kind.

synthesis.summary: The panel converges on NEEDS-WORK. The Vonage serializer itself is roughly the right shape, but the FastAPI transport's new fixed-size packetization path is the central problem: it has no terminal flush (trailing audio is dropped), applies indiscriminately to all bytes payloads (corrupting non-audio binaries), and welds serialize+buffer+chunk+send into one function while overselling pacing it does not implement. Secondary issues are unenforced PCM16 assumptions, a silently breaking param rename, and DTMF parsing that accepts two undocumented shapes. Fix gating and flushing, extract a chunker filter, enforce the format contract, and either implement pacing or rename honestly.
